burlington.label: Burlington County Library System museum-pass terms

operators.name: Boston Public Library → New England Aquarium

prep.label: First, reserve the pass
prep.text: Use an active physical Boston Public Library card to reserve the digital Aquarium pass for your visit date.

prep.label: Then pick a time or go to the box office
prep.text: Book the same date on the Aquarium site for a specific time. With the pass you can also ask at the box office for the next slot available that day.

prep.label: Bring the actual pass
prep.text: The Aquarium asks to see the digital library pass at the box office and rejects screenshots. An online reservation and its library pass must show the same date.

operators.name: Shorewood Library → Betty Brinn Children’s Museum

prep.label: Collect in person
prep.text: Use a valid Milwaukee County Federated Library System card at the Shorewood checkout desk. Passes are first come, first served.

prep.label: Check the museum rules
prep.text: Use the library pass in person. Children need an adult. The museum requires an appointment when adults are visiting without a child.

prep.label: Return to Shorewood
prep.text: The normal checkout is three days followed by a three-day grace period. Pick up and return the pass at Shorewood.

prep.label: Reserve the library pass
prep.text: Look for MASS MoCA in the Athenaeum’s reservation system. The library excludes children’s cards and limits reservations to one pass a week.

prep.label: Redeem at the box office
prep.text: The museum accepts the participating library’s physical or digital pass on the visit day for general gallery admission.

prep.label: Verify your library’s pass format
prep.text: The library publishes different pickup and return rules for facsimile and standard passes. Confirm the version issued with your reservation.

operators.name: Burlington County Library System → participating venues

prep.label: Check venue openings and time slots
prep.text: For venues that require a timed ticket, check whether the museum has an opening before reserving the library pass.

prep.label: Reserve both for the same day where required
prep.text: Reserve the library pass for the day of the visit. Then use the venue’s site to get its timed ticket for the same day when the venue requires it.

prep.label: Check format and return options
prep.text: Printable passes are valid for a specific date. Return physical passes to the same library. Review Sunday and New York City exceptions on the library page.

operators.name: Toronto Public Library → Aga Khan Museum

prep.label: Reserve with an adult library card
prep.text: Use tpl:map to choose an available date. Download or print the pass as directed by the library.

prep.label: Go to Guest Services
prep.text: Redeem the pass for general admission at the museum’s Guest Services Desk. Confirm the museum hours and check ticketed events separately.

tasks.label: Use the pass to book a venue time
Redeem the pass at the venue
Check how many people it covers

rules.text: Reserve a digital Aquarium pass with an active physical BPL card. A card alone does not redeem admission.
Once you have the digital library pass, book a ticket for the same date to secure your preferred available time.
Bring the digital pass to the box office. Without an online booking, you can ask for the next available slot on the pass date. Screenshots of the pass are excluded.
The Boston Public Library digital pass covers general admission for up to four people on its date. The Aquarium publishes separate terms for coupons from other libraries.
This route uses a digital library pass. There is no physical library pass in the Aquarium’s published instructions.
Passes are held at the checkout desk and offered first come, first served when available.
The museum says its online purchase flow does not take library passes. Its appointment rule for adults visiting without a child is separate.
Use the library pass in person. Check the museum’s child accompaniment and adult-only appointment rules first.
Shorewood lists admission for up to six guests per pass. Children must be accompanied by an adult 18 or older.
Return it to Shorewood Library. The regular loan period is three days with a three-day grace period.
The Athenaeum lists MASS MoCA and accepts advance pass reservations. Children’s cards cannot reserve passes.
Present the pass from the named participating library at the museum box office on the day of your visit.
The pass covers gallery admission for up to two adults and two children under 16. Performances and special events are excluded.
The library’s standard passes normally come back the next morning. Facsimile passes do not come back. Confirm the format on your booking.
Use a library card to reserve a pass for the day of use. The published booking window goes up to 45 days ahead.
Where a timed ticket is required, check for venue openings, reserve the library pass and then book a venue slot for the same day.
A printable library pass alone will not admit you to a venue that requires a separate timed ticket. Check its entry instructions.
Physical passes go back to the checkout location with the published deadline and route exceptions. Printable passes do not require return.
Reserve through tpl:map with an adult Toronto Public Library card and print or download the pass.
The library lists the Guest Services Desk as the place to redeem this pass for general admission.
General admission covers up to two adults including the cardholder. Ages 25 and under are free. Children age 14 or younger need an adult.
The library’s listed route uses a printed or downloaded reservation. No physical pass checkout is part of that route.
